description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers adjudicating a go/no-go from typed evidence and the one-red floor. Should-not-trigger covers the neighbours that PRODUCE the evidence rather than adjudicate it (logging-monitoring, alerting-doctrine, server-hardening), the pre-merge release checklist (launch-readiness) and an incident already running (incident-commander).
